notes: The of persons was read as the English verb's valency reaching a bare object (rule 44) rather than as a construct relation, since פָּנִים is absolute here.
The belonging לְ is the clause's predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula, headed on of (rule 49); the italic sayings is a supplied lexical noun and is added.
MACULA segments no article in לַחֲכָמִים, so the the of the wise is the anarthrous substantive's own under rule 46.
